description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the IDGeneratorService in the OrangeHRM core service module. It contains setup and test methods to verify ID generation logic, involving mocks of DAO interactions.

classes.name: IDGeneratorServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class that tests the IDGeneratorService, including ID incrementing and retrieval logic, within the OrangeHRM core service plugin.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the IDGeneratorService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetNextID
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of the next ID for various entities, mocking DAO responses.

methods.name: getNextIDDataProvider
methods.description: Provides multiple sets of test data for getNextID tests.

methods.name: testIncrementId
methods.description: Verifies that the incrementId method properly updates the ID for a given entity.
